recommendation.t: Defend the book — 1119 branches (56%) face 3+ rival branches within 2 km; hold share on service and turnaround.
Grow farm lending — 870 branches (43%) enjoy a crop-price tailwind; collections favourable, room to lend.
Push vehicle-title — 612 branches (30%) have prime collateral density; lead with vehicle-title products.
Expand — 223 branches (11%) sit on prime white-space with thin competition; lead the region's acquisition here.
De-risk agri — 89 branches (4%) sit in stressed crop catchments; tighten agri exposure and watch collections.

national.headline: Deleveraging backdrop (household debt 87.5% and falling) eases borrower risk — a window to grow selectively. Priority: expand where white-space is thin-competition (most in East · Eastern Seaboard), de-risk agri-stressed branches (most in Central & Bangkok), and push gold-collateral products while gold is bid.
